Carter, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, commented as follows: “As we continue to move through 2026, our focus remains squarely on trying to maximize shareholder value through our expanded evaluation of strategic alternatives, proactive asset management, expense management, and efforts to improve leasing and occupancy. During the quarter, we endeavored to make progress on several important strategic initiatives, while maintaining financial and strategic flexibility. Importantly, our recent refinancing of our outstanding debt has provided the Company with increased flexibility, allowing us to pursue strategic initiatives in a disciplined and thoughtful manner. The Company will not be holding a conference call/webcast this quarter. This press release, along with other news about FSP, is available on the Internet at www.fspreit.com .
